applicable_when: The kernel is L1/shared-memory bound (L1/TEX at 90.1%, DRAM only 4.71%). The dominant bottleneck is 8-way shared memory bank conflicts on 69.85% of shared loads, causing MIO scoreboard stalls that account for 58.5% of all stall cycles. The current fixed tile (BLOCK_M=128, BLOCK_N=64, BLOCK_K=32) uses 168 registers/thread, limiting occupancy to 18.75% (3 blocks/SM). Bank conflicts arise because BLOCK_K=32 with the B matrix transposed stride (stride_bn=672) causes threads in the same warp to access the same shared memory bank. Increasing BLOCK_K to 64+ improves K-dimension tile granularity and reduces the relative cost of the transposed access pattern. Adding @triton.autotune lets the runtime select the best (BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, BLOCK_K, num_warps, num_stages) combination for this H200 Hopper GPU, including configurations with smaller BLOCK_M that reduce register pressure and improve occupancy.
